models_evaluated: ML-based CDSS for oesophageal cancer treatment decisions trained on historical treatment decisions

links.outcome: Relative influence of age and gender in ML model versus clinicians' stated importance
links.effect: Age and gender had greater influence on the model than their conscious importance to clinicians would support, although other influential factors agreed between clinicians and the model.
links.quote: There was agreement between clinicians and the model in many of the most influential factors in decision making, although age and gender had greater influence on the model than their conscious importance to clinicians would support.

screen.reason: Survey of multidisciplinary clinicians assessing perceptions, trust, decision-making factors, and barriers to implementation of an ML-based clinical decision support system for oesophageal cancer.
